title: Open redirect: customer login `next` param redirects to external sites (//host and absolute URLs)
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/account/actions.ts:34 (redirect(next.startsWith("/") ? next : "/account") lets '//host' through) and account/login/page.tsx:13 (if (customer) redirect(next) with no check at all)
steps: 1) Anonymous: open http://demo-cafe.localhost:3000/account/login?next=%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fphish, request OTP, enter the dev code. 2) Already logged in: open /account/login?next=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fphish
expected: Only same-site relative paths are honoured (reject values starting with // or /\ or containing a scheme); fall back to /account
actual: After OTP verify the browser lands on http://example.com/phish; a logged-in visit to /account/login?next=https://example.com/phish redirects straight to https://example.com/phish
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/storefront_shop-account.ts demo-cafe basic -> 'A14 logged-in /account/login?next=https://example.com/phish -> https://example.com/phish' and 'B1 verify with next=//example.com/phish -> http://example.com/phish'
suggestedFix: Add a safeNext() helper: accept only strings that start with a single '/' and not '//' or '/\', else '/account'; use it in both LoginPage and verifyOtpAction

title: Account takeover: guest checkout with a victim's phone + attacker's email attaches the email to the victim's customer, then email-OTP login opens the victim's account
where: packages/core/src/customer/index.ts:136-140 (upsertGuestCustomer: line 139 'if (!existing.email && email) patch.email = email') + verifyOtp resolving the customer by email (index.ts:96-97); called from packages/modules/commerce/src/services/orders.ts:130-133
steps: 1) Victim logs in on demo-cafe with phone 0854529323 (customer has phone only) and places order #1007. 2) Attacker (fresh browser) adds an item, checks out as guest with name 'ผู้โจมตี', phone 0854529323, email attacker+54559220@example.org -> order #1008. 3) Attacker logs in at /account/login with that email (OTP goes to attacker's own inbox). 4) Open /account and /account/orders
expected: Unverified contact data typed at guest checkout never changes an existing customer's login identifiers; email OTP login only resolves to a customer whose email was verified by that customer
actual: Attacker's session is the victim's account: /account shows h1 'เหยื่อ ทดสอบ' + victim phone 0854529323, /account/orders lists victim order #1007 and the detail page opens (name, phone, items, shipping address on delivery orders)
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/storefront_shop-account.ts demo-cafe takeover -> 'C5 attacker /account h1: เหยื่อ ทดสอบ | 0854529323', 'C6 attacker sees orders: [#1008, #1007]', 'C7 attacker opened victim order: ... คำสั่งซื้อ #1007 ...'. DB: customers row phone=0854529323 now has email=attacker+54559220@example.org, orders=2
suggestedFix: In upsertGuestCustomer never write email/phone onto an existing customer (store guest contact on the order only), or keep separate verified flags (emailVerifiedAt/phoneVerifiedAt) and have verifyOtp only match verified identifiers; consider marking which identifiers were OTP-verified

title: OTP brute-force protection is weak: no rate limit on OTP requests, a new OTP resets the 5-attempt budget, and parallel verify requests bypass the attempt cap
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/account/actions.ts:12-19 (requestOtpAction, no throttle) and packages/core/src/customer/index.ts:55-66 (requestOtp inserts a new row every call; verifyOtp checks only the latest row's attempts); attempts update is read-modify-write at index.ts:91 (set({ attempts: latest.attempts + 1 }) with no row lock / atomic increment)
steps: On http://demo-cafe.localhost:3000/account/login request an OTP for 0854671200, submit wrong codes, then request again 8 more times back-to-back
expected: Per-target and per-IP throttling (e.g. 1 request / 60 s, max ~5 / hour) and a lockout that survives requesting a new code
actual: Every request succeeds instantly; 10 OTP rows created for the same phone in ~90 s, the newest rows have attempts=0 even though earlier rows had 4 failed attempts. Race: after 1 wrong code, 20 parallel replays of the verify server action with wrong codes returned 12 'รหัสไม่ถูกต้อง' (evaluated guesses) and only 8 'ลองผิดหลายครั้งเกินไป'; the row ends with attempts=5 although 13 wrong codes were checked
evidence: storefront_shop-account.ts demo-cafe otp -> 'D3 8/8 back-to-back OTP requests for the same phone succeeded in 51702ms'; DB customer_otps where target='0854671200' -> 10 rows 12:44:50..12:46:23, attempts 4,4,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0. grep for ratelimit/throttle in apps/web/src and packages/core/src returns nothing; storefront_shop-otprace.ts -> '20 parallel wrong codes -> {"invalid":12,"too_many":8} phone 0856117090'; DB customer_otps target=0856117090 attempts=5
suggestedFix: Before inserting, count recent OTPs for (tenant,target) and for the request IP (e.g. reject if one in the last 60 s or >5 in the last hour, Thai error 'ขอรหัสบ่อยเกินไป กรุณารอสักครู่'); count failed attempts across all of a target's rows in the window, not only the latest row; make the increment atomic and conditional: UPDATE customer_otps SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = $1 AND attempts < 5 RETURNING attempts (or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) and treat 0 rows as too_many

title: Unauthenticated POST /api/forms/<any-slug> creates a new form definition in the tenant (unbounded spam of admin form list)
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/api/forms/[slug]/route.ts:22-37 (insert into forms when slug not found)
expected: 404 for a slug that is not an existing active form (only the built-in 'contact' form may be lazily created)
actual: 200 {"ok":true}; a new forms row slug/name 'qa-bogus-19614' is created for demo-corporate with 1 submission
evidence: curl -> '{"ok":true} 200'; DB forms: {ten:demo-corporate, slug:qa-bogus-19614, name:qa-bogus-19614, created_at 2026-10-16 12:49:25, subs:1}
suggestedFix: Only auto-create when slug === 'contact' (or a whitelist of template form slugs); otherwise return 404. Also return a clean 4xx instead of throwing when form.active is false (route.ts:40 currently throws -> 500)

title: Contact form: phone accepts any text and server errors are one generic message with no field hint
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/api/forms/[slug]/route.ts:6-12 (phone z.string().min(6) only; single error 'ข้อมูลไม่ถูกต้อง'); packages/storefront/src/sections/contact-form.tsx:52 (no pattern)
steps: On /contact of demo-shop/cafe/corporate fill name+message, phone '12' -> submit; then phone 'abcdefgh' -> submit
expected: Thai field-level error such as 'กรุณากรอกเบอร์โทรศัพท์ให้ถูกต้อง' and letters rejected
actual: phone '12' -> HTTP 400 with only 'ข้อมูลไม่ถูกต้อง' (which field is not said); phone 'abcdefgh' -> HTTP 200 and stored as the lead's phone
evidence: storefront_shop-forms.ts output: '[demo-shop] phone "12" -> http 400 msg: "ข้อมูลไม่ถูกต้อง"', '[demo-shop] phone "abcdefgh" -> http 200' (same on demo-cafe, demo-corporate); the 400 also logs a console error 'Failed to load resource ... 400'
suggestedFix: Validate phone with normalizeThaiPhone (or /^[0-9+\-\s]{9,15}$/) and return {error, field} so the form can show the message under the field

title: Corporate template links to /blog (header, mobile nav, footer, sitemap) but no blog route exists -> 404
where: packages/templates/src/corporate.ts:26,33 (nav href '/blog'); apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/sitemap.xml/route.ts (emits /blog/<slug> for published posts); no blog route under apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/
steps: Open http://demo-corporate.localhost:3000/ and click 'บทความ' in the header (or mobile menu / footer); also open http://demo-corporate.localhost:3000/blog/why-nextjs from sitemap.xml
expected: A blog index listing the 2 published posts of demo-corporate and a post detail page
actual: /blog -> HTTP 404 (console 'Failed to load resource ... 404'); sitemap URLs /blog/pdpa-checklist-2026 and /blog/why-nextjs -> 404
evidence: storefront_shop-crawl.txt: '404 /blog <- home:header | Northstar Studio | ERR Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404'; mobile nav links '/services /work /blog /about /contact'; DB navigation header+footer contain {href:'/blog',label:'บทความ'}; posts table has 2 rows for demo-corporate; curl of sitemap URLs -> '404 http://demo-corporate.localhost:3000/blog/pdpa-checklist-2026', '404 .../blog/why-nextjs'
suggestedFix: Add (sites)/rw/[tenantId]/blog/page.tsx + blog/[slug]/page.tsx rendering posts (bodyHtml sanitized), or remove /blog from the corporate template nav and from sitemap until it exists

title: CMS pages and collection pages drop the site meta description and og: tags (and CMS pages have no <h1>)
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/[...slug]/page.tsx:15-21 (returns description: undefined and openGraph: undefined which wipes the layout defaults); section headings render as h2; same pattern in collections/[slug]/page.tsx:18 (description: cat.description ?? undefined, openGraph: cat.image ? {...} : undefined)
expected: Each page has a description (page seo or site default), og:title/og:description/og:image, and exactly one h1
actual: /about, /contact, /privacy, /terms, /refund, /work, /careers on demo-shop/cafe/corporate output only <title>; no meta description, no og:*; 0 h1 elements (first heading is h2). Home and /products keep the defaults. demo-cafe /collections/cakes|pastry|drinks also have no description and no og:* (categories without image); demo-shop collections keep og:image but lose the description
evidence: storefront_shop-crawl.json rows for these URLs: desc=null, ogTitle=null, h1=0 (e.g. '200 /about |T: เกี่ยวกับเรา · Northstar Studio |D: - |OG: - noimg |h1: 0'); curl /about shows only '<title>เกี่ยวกับเรา · Northstar Studio</title>'
suggestedFix: Only set keys that have values (spread conditionally) and fall back to runtime tagline / page.title for og:title; render the first section heading of a CMS page as h1 (or add a visually-hidden h1 with page.title)

title: sitemap.xml: non-ASCII product slugs not percent-encoded, category pages missing, noindex pages not excluded
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/sitemap.xml/route.ts:26-33 (raw slug in <loc>, no categories, no seo.noindex filter)
expected: <loc> values are RFC 3986 URLs (encodeURIComponent on slugs), /collections and /collections/<slug> are listed, pages with seo.noindex are omitted
actual: <loc>http://demo-shop.localhost:3000/products/qa-เสื้อยืดทดสอบ-nkovy</loc> and .../products/เสื้อ-ทดสอบ-qa are raw Thai; no /collections URLs although 3 categories exist; pages query has no noindex filter
evidence: grep -P '[^\x00-\x7F]' on fetched sitemap printed the 2 Thai URLs; sitemap has 21 entries and none contain /collections
suggestedFix: Use encodeURIComponent(slug) for every path segment; add categories when commerce is enabled; filter pages where seo->>'noindex' = 'true'

title: Catalog empty state says 'ยังไม่มีสินค้าในร้าน' (store has no products) for out-of-range pages and unknown ?category=
expected: Out-of-range page -> redirect to last page or 'ไม่พบสินค้าในหน้านี้' with a link back to page 1; unknown category -> 404 (as /collections/bogus-cat already does) or 'ไม่พบหมวดหมู่'
actual: All three render HTTP 200 with heading 'ยังไม่มีสินค้าในร้าน' although the store has 14 active products
evidence: curl text of each URL contains 'ยังไม่มีสินค้าในร้าน'; storefront_shop-catalog.ts: '200 /products?page=2 | cards=0', '200 /products?category=bogus | cards=0', while '/products?q=zzzzqqq' correctly shows 'ไม่พบสินค้าที่ตรงกับเงื่อนไข'
suggestedFix: Treat page>1 and category as filters (filtered = !!(q||min||max||category||page>1)) or compare result.total>0; notFound() when the category slug does not exist

title: No favicon on tenant sites: /favicon.ico is 404 and no <link rel=icon> when the tenant has no brand favicon
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/layout.tsx:25 (icons only when theme.brand.favicon); apps/web/public has no favicon; proxy matcher excludes favicon.ico so it never reaches the tenant
expected: A default icon (platform favicon, or one generated from the tenant initial/primary colour) and a <link rel=icon> on every page
actual: favicon.ico -> 404 (0 bytes); home HTML has no icon/apple-touch-icon link (all 3 demo tenants have brand.favicon = null) so browsers show a blank tab icon and log a 404
evidence: curl output 'favicon.ico 404  0'; grep for rel=icon on demo-shop home returned nothing; DB tenants.theme.brand is null for every demo tenant
suggestedFix: Fall back to an app/icon.tsx (ImageResponse with tenant initial + primary colour) or a platform default /favicon.ico in apps/web/public

title: GET /api/payments/<non-uuid> returns HTTP 500 instead of 404
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/api/payments/[paymentId]/route.ts:5-8 (paymentId passed straight to a uuid column query)
expected: 404 {"error":"not found"} like for an unknown valid uuid
actual: HTTP 500 with empty body (Postgres rejects the non-uuid value); a valid-but-unknown uuid correctly returns 404
suggestedFix: Validate with z.string().uuid().safeParse(paymentId) and return 404 before querying (same in slip/route.ts)

title: No cart merge on login: a signed-in customer's cart is bound to one browser cookie, so the same account on another device sees a different cart
where: packages/modules/commerce/src/services/cart.ts:129-155 (findActiveCart/getOrCreateCart resolve only by cookie token; customerId is stamped but never used to load or merge); account/actions.ts verifyOtpAction does not touch the cart
steps: Device A: log in on demo-cafe with phone P, add ลาเต้ x2. Device B (fresh browser): add ครัวซองต์ x1 as guest, then log in with the same phone P; read /api/cart on both
expected: After login on B the account cart contains both lines (guest lines merged into the customer's active cart), and A sees the same cart
actual: B shows only 'ครัวซองต์เนยฝรั่งเศส x1', A still shows only 'ลาเต้คั่วเอง (เย็น) x2'. (Guest cart does survive login on the same browser - OK)
evidence: storefront_shop-account.ts demo-cafe merge -> 'E3 device B after login, cart lines: [ ครัวซองต์เนยฝรั่งเศส x1 ]', 'E4 device A cart lines: [ ลาเต้คั่วเอง (เย็น) x2 ]'
suggestedFix: On successful OTP verify, find the customer's latest active cart; merge the cookie cart's lines into it (capped by stock), mark the other as merged, and set the cookie to the surviving cart token

title: CMS fallback pages under module routes keep the module's static <title> (corporate /services titled 'บริการทั้งหมด' instead of the CMS page 'บริการ')
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/services/page.tsx:15 (export const metadata = { title: 'บริการทั้งหมด' }) + lib/cms-fallback.tsx (no metadata); same pattern in products/cart/collections/menu/order/reserve/book/packages pages
expected: Title/description/og from the CMS page 'services' (title 'บริการ', its seo) when the booking module is off
actual: <title>บริการทั้งหมด · Northstar Studio</title> (the booking module's listing title) on the corporate CMS services page

title: Login field invites 'เบอร์โทร หรืออีเมล' but is type=tel/inputmode=tel, so phones show a numeric keypad and email login cannot be typed
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/account/login/otp-form.tsx:62 (<Input id="otp-target" type="tel" inputMode="tel" autoComplete="tel" placeholder="08x-xxx-xxxx หรืออีเมล">)
steps: Open http://demo-shop.localhost:3000/account/login on a phone and tap the field to enter an email address
expected: A text field (type=text, inputmode=email or a phone/email switch) so both phone and email can be entered on mobile keyboards
actual: Mobile browsers open the telephone keypad (digits, + * #) with no letters or '@'; email OTP login, which the backend supports (parseOtpTarget accepts emails), is effectively unavailable on phones; autocomplete=tel also never suggests the email
evidence: Code at otp-form.tsx:62; server accepts email: storefront_shop-account.ts takeover run logged in with 'attacker+54559220@example.org' on desktop (C4 -> /account/orders)
suggestedFix: Use type="text" inputMode="email" autoComplete="username" or two tabs (เบอร์โทร / อีเมล) that switch inputMode between tel and email
